# Marimo Studio 0.4.0

Marimo Studio 0.4.0 places notebook results in typeset documents. Quarto, Typst, and LaTeX views render papers, reports, and bulletins from the cells, outputs, and values of a live notebook. Lens traces a chart or a table cell inside a rendered PDF back to the cell that computed it. A new **New view** dialog previews every starter, and third-party providers build on the same public SDK as the built-in ones.

## Write papers and reports from notebook results

- **Quarto.** The `quarto` provider renders a Quarto Markdown document. The `{{< marimo cell="chart" >}}` shortcode places a cell or an output, and `{{< marimo value="summary.rooms" >}}` places a value inside a sentence. Studio renders with `--no-execute`, so computation stays in the notebook.
- **Typst.** The `typst` provider compiles a Typst template to PDF. `marimo_value()`, `marimo_output()`, and `marimo_cell()` read notebook results, and each call falls back to its `default`, so the same project also compiles with plain `typst compile`. Embedded fonts, the project's `fonts/`, and a fixed compile clock make the same values produce the same PDF. Install the compiler with the `typst` extra.
- **LaTeX.** The `latex` provider compiles `main.tex` with Tectonic through the bundled `marimo.sty`. `\marimovalue` expands in titles, bookmarks, and `\ifnum` tests, `\marimonum` and `\marimodate` format through siunitx and datetime2, and `\marimorows` writes one table row per item. The first compile prints each fallback, so the paper typesets before a kernel connects.
- Figures are drawn at the size the document gives them. `marimo_output("chart", height: 4cm)` and `\marimographics[height=4cm]{chart}` keep the notebook's aspect ratio, and labels keep their point size.
- Documents follow the reader's notebook in the Python runtime, Browser edit mode, and Prepared previews. A `zero-python` export renders one document per prepared state. Browser run mode and `wasm` exports report `render-results-unavailable`.
- Preview lays PDF pages on a page desk with selectable text and a Download link, and keeps the last document on screen while the next one renders. A control change cancels a render that the new value makes outdated.

## Render any file from notebook results

- A view provider declares renders in `inspect()` and turns the reader's values, outputs, and cells into a bundle of files, such as a PDF, a video with its poster, or HTML with images. A page shows the bundle with one host:

  ```html
  <marimo-output render="main.typ"></marimo-output>
  ```

- A page can present the files itself through `host.marimoRender`, for example in a custom video player. Rendered bundles are content-addressed, shared between readers, and served with byte ranges for media seeking.
- `<marimo-output value="chart" accept="image/svg+xml image/png">` shows a value as the first listed image type it supports, in every runtime and in Prepared exports.

## Trace parts of rendered files with Lens

Renders can return regions: rectangles on a PDF page or an image, or a span of video frames, each naming the notebook results it shows. Preview makes each region a [Lens](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-lens) target that traces to the cell that computed it and the value it narrows to, such as `report.readings[6].occupancy`.

![Selecting a chart, a key figure, and one table cell inside a Typst PDF with Lens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/5d453fd0df94c1289873e021eb9a06bf2b7091fd/typst-pdf.gif)

- The Typst and LaTeX providers locate every placed output and cell on its page. Mark other parts of a document with `marimo_region()` or `\marimoregion`.
- A video provider returns regions with time spans, and the targets follow the shapes as the movie plays.

![Lens targets following shapes through a Manim video, then selecting one cell of the joint probability table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marimo-team/marimo-studio/5d453fd0df94c1289873e021eb9a06bf2b7091fd/manim-video.gif)

## Create views from the New view dialog

**New view** opens a dialog with a searchable starter list grouped by package, and the selected starter's preview, details, and settings beside it. A starter whose tools are missing says what it needs, such as "Needs Quarto 1.9.38+".

![The New view dialog with the React starter selected](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/peter-gy/6c0b2fd14046498ce58df250f11015b8/raw/ce7a0a41136bedcd63b2faa060111a76e955225d/hero.png)

- Set the view title, make it the default view, and choose starter settings, such as the paper size for Typst and LaTeX or a table of contents for Quarto.
- `marimo-studio view create report --title "Quarterly report" --setting KEY=VALUE --make-default` and `Workspace.create_view("report", title="Quarterly report", settings={…}, make_default=True)` send the same request as the dialog.

## Commit views beside the notebook

New views live in `studio/<notebook>/`, and their build state lives in marimo's output directory:

```text
analysis.py
studio/analysis/dashboard/view.toml               # authored, committed
__marimo__/studio/analysis/dashboard/.artifacts/  # generated, ignores itself
```

A repository that ignores `__marimo__/` can commit its views, and a host that discards `__marimo__/` keeps them. `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX` moves build state out of the working tree together with marimo's caches, and `marimo-studio status` prints both locations. Views created by 0.3 keep working in place. [Upgrade from 0.3](https://marimo-team.github.io/marimo-studio/reference/compatibility#upgrade-from-0-3) shows how to move them.

## Run in pixi environments

- Studio runs inside an activated [pixi](https://pixi.prefix.dev/) workspace, and the dependency doctor reads the workspace's conda and PyPI declarations. Outside the workspace, commands print the `pixi run` command to use.
- A notebook can declare the system tools its views need in its inline `[tool.pixi.dependencies]`. With `marimo edit --sandbox=pixi`, view builds take Tectonic and other provider tools from that script environment, so the LaTeX view builds with nothing installed globally.
- `marimo-studio starters --target notebook.py` reports starter availability for one notebook.

## Build view providers on the public SDK

- `marimo_studio.view_providers` is the provider contract. The built-in providers import only that module, so an installed provider can do everything they do.
- Inspection reports `documents`, `inputs`, `sites`, and renders. `ProviderError` turns an author-fixable problem into a located diagnostic.
- Helpers cover common provider work: `project_files`, `copy_inputs`, `probe_tool`, `find_tool`, `html_sites`, and `PackagedStarter` with `create_starter`.
- Starters can declare an icon, a preview image, a homepage, and typed settings for the New view dialog.
- `marimo_studio.view_providers.testing.check_provider()` runs a provider through Studio's inspection, build, render, and publication checks.

## Authoring updates

- Source highlights Python, Markdown with YAML front matter, JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, SCSS, LaTeX, and Lua.
- Export and preflight warn with `prepared-states-skip-control-values` when `states.yaml` leaves out values a slider, number, dropdown, radio, checkbox, or switch can take, and name the control and the skipped values.
- The docs start from what a view is and how one view travels from its files to the browser, with a glossary, a Lens guide, and interactive figures. The examples add Quarto, Typst, and LaTeX views.

## Fixes

- Every Studio tab loads when several tabs are open on one server. Event streams use WebSocket connections, which leave the browser's six HTTP connections per host free.
- `mo.ui.data_editor`, `mo.image`, `mo.download`, and notebook `public/` files load inside views, including Prepared views.
- A failed build keeps the previous build on screen with one notice, and `marimoStudio.diagnostics()` lists the build error.
- Preview keeps showing the newest publication after rapid saves, waits for a notebook's long first run, and reloads after a server restart. Projections stay live while an unrelated cell has a syntax error.
- Builds and Source recover from cancelled scans, files added during inspection, and damaged build state. Provider processes stop with the server, and errors name a recovery step.
- A failed Deno package download points to the network connection and proxy or npm registry settings.
- Abandoned renders leave the server log quiet.
- New views leave out Python bytecode caches from packaged starters.
- A source checkout with a stale browser build stops with the changed file and asks for `make build`. A checkout without one asks for `make setup`.

## Upgrade notes

- **Proxies.** Forward WebSocket upgrades beneath `/_marimo-studio/` for live updates, also when marimo streams kernel messages over server-sent events.
- **Existing views rebuild once.** Artifact manifests move to schema 4.
- **Readiness.** `data-marimo-studio-state` stays `ready` after a failed build. Compare the revision or check `marimoStudio.diagnostics()` to detect a stale build.
- **Third-party providers.** Records follow the SDK names, `ProviderInfo.options` replaces `api_version`, and documents render through `RenderProvider`, `RenderRequest`, `RenderResult`, and `render_page()`. Starter files use `__VIEW_TITLE_HTML__` and `__VIEW_TITLE_JSON__`, and `StarterContext` requires `title`. Pin `marimo-studio>=0.4,<0.5`. [Third-party view providers](https://marimo-team.github.io/marimo-studio/reference/compatibility#third-party-view-providers) lists the changes.

## Compatibility

Marimo Studio 0.4.0 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and [Marimo](https://marimo.io/) 0.25.1. It requires [marimo-export](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-export) 0.2.1 or newer. The `deno` extra provides [Deno](https://docs.deno.com/) 2.9.5 or newer for [React](https://react.dev/), [Reveal.js](https://revealjs.com/), [Svelte](https://svelte.dev/), and [Observable Notebook Kit](https://observablehq.com/notebook-kit/kit) authoring. The `typst` extra provides the [Typst](https://typst.app/) compiler 0.15 or newer. The Quarto provider needs [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) 1.9.38 or newer on `PATH`, and the LaTeX provider needs [Tectonic](https://tectonic-typesetting.github.io/) 0.15 or newer on `PATH` or in the notebook's pixi script environment. pixi environments need [pixi](https://pixi.prefix.dev/) 0.80 or newer. The `lens` extra requires [marimo-lens](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-lens) 0.2.3 or newer, and Lens 0.2.4 records the page or time span of a selected region.
